settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.database_helper: Each account needs a database of its own. A new name creates an empty database; an existing database without account is taken over.
settings.database_pattern: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and _ $ ( ) + -
settings.database_maxLength: Must be at most 238 characters long
settings.https_warning_description: Obsidian on iOS and Android only connects to servers with a valid certificate. Request a Let's Encrypt certificate or use another trusted certificate for this host.
settings.passphrase_hint: Also enable end-to-end encryption in the plugin and keep its passphrase safe: it is not stored on this server and cannot be recovered.
settings.database_in_use: This database already belongs to another account
settings.accounts_description: Enter the server URI and the values of one account in the Self-hosted LiveSync plugin of Obsidian (remote type CouchDB). Each account can only access its own database; use one database per vault.
settings.remove_account_description: Obsidian clients that use this account can no longer sync. Without the option below, the database is kept and only the CouchDB administrator can access it.
settings.remove_account_database_warning: All notes in this database are deleted on the server. This cannot be undone.
settings.username_helper: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; starts with a letter. The password is generated.
settings.username_invalid: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, . _ and - (at most 64 characters); "admin" is reserved
settings.username_exists: An account with this name already exists
